text:
Situation: Prochlorperazine 25 mg suppository stock across Corvale sites totals 326 eachs, providing approximately 18 days of supply at current usage rates. Corvale East holds 139 eachs at 7.8 per day for 17.9 days. Corvale General holds 161 eachs at 8.6 per day for 18.8 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 26 eachs at 1.5 per day for 17.9 days.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, FDA's drug shortage list does not include prochlorperazine. The current product label identifies PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as the registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-08-20.

Our position: Current inventory supports near-term needs but offers limited buffer. Two alternate manufacturers, Cosette Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and Padagis US LLC, are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Cosette Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as primary alternate source; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with Padagis US LLC as secondary alternate source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at all three sites; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
